verdict.rationale: BAMF is Germany's Federal Office for Migration and Refugees, a government agency offering migration, asylum and integration information and services rather than a software product. Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking as an AI-native user is a software-tool axis, so this is a category mismatch. Nothing in the evidence shows BAMF ships software with telemetry controls that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
